notes: State graphs are guarded recommendations, not executable business logic.
Creating a free/instant booking can commit requested and confirmed within one transaction; requested need not be customer-visible.
Reschedule is a versioned command on a confirmed booking, not cancellation followed by hopeful rebooking.
Payment refund/dispute are separate records; succeeded Payment is not changed to refunded.
Retry failed provider work with a linked new attempt, not an illegal transition out of a terminal state.

Campaign approval invalidates on material edit; notify provider accepted work cannot be recalled. Notification suppression during dispatch is allowed only with definite preacceptance outcome; unknown result reconciles first.
Failed provider/pass retry creates linked attempt with same logical intent and valid idempotency; no terminal financial outcome reset.
CapabilityReadiness is derived, not arbitrarily set by client or guidance dismissal.
